propositions: inspect-ai is never imported in src/rebar despite being declared as a dependency; it exists only as a registry name in _optional.py
the [eval] extra is the sole consumer of inspect-ai, and the only two [tool.uv] conflicts entries (eval vs bedrock, eval vs dev) exist solely to accommodate the boto3 pinning diamond it creates

the inspect-ai dependency forces a click < 8.2.2 cap that caused pip-audit to fail on vulnerable click 8.2.1 (PYSEC-2026-2132) and required a REMOVE-WHEN override; upstream fixed the cap in click 8.3.2

the existing implementation comment in eval.py explicitly disclaims the Inspect AI routing ('NOT routed through Inspect AI... would add a dependency and impedance mismatch'), contradicting the module docstring claims on lines 6 and 21

the [eval] extra cannot be smoke-tested in any CI lane because the only job installing it (prompt-eval.yml eval-live) is dispatch/weekly-only, continue-on-error, and pytest-less due to the eval-dev conflict
